apps.localizedDescription: A network listening post and payload instrument for iOS: BLE ears, a send/serve mouth, EMCON, Knocktalk — and Skelli, the onboard intelligence who runs it all with you.
apps.name: nightjar
apps.versionDescription: v10- chorus. The tenth version opens: the console is an operating system, Skelli is awake inside it, and every instrument in the house plays at once. What chorus comes to mean, it will say as it lands.
